title: Zesty German Potato Dumplings
description: Pungent and pillowy, these German potato dumplings are a kid-friendly dish featuring black pepper and infused oil, making them a great halal-friendly option. They are perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Combine grated potatoes, flour, infused oil, black pepper, and salt in a large bowl.
Add eggs and chopped onion to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the dumplings.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and melt butter on top of each dumpling.
Serve the dumplings hot and enjoy.
